name: Single Combat: Halla versus Irena
description: Opening elimination bout at d1/day Lists. Live inspected weapons. Victory by concession or marshal stoppage when unable to continue; immediate halt at surrender, no striking a helpless opponent. Halla full chainmail and helm, battleaxe and round shield; handaxe and dagger at belt. Irena unarmoured in travelling coat, spear two hands, dagger sheathed. Start at spear reach with both ready. One proactive action per combat round; remaining AP reactions only. Halla3AP Irena2AP. No automatic champion result.
summary: Halla wins opening Single Combat against Irena by marshal stoppage in round1. Axe71/81 hit vs parry87/68 fail; Disarm resistance79/68 fails vs original71. Spear drops on sand. Damage6 plus mastery2 totals8 to Right Leg, HP5 to -3 Serious. Endurance87/55 fails; leg disabled, unable to attack2turns. Halla uninjured Luck3. Healers approach; no treatment yet resolved.
